g.text: Hardware Connection Guide Rev 2 Baseline | Dual-Rail Power | E-Stop Interlock
IEC 60601-1 Type BF Isolated Biomedical EMG | ISO 13849 PL d Safety
COMPLETE ELECTRICAL SCHEMATIC & CIRCUIT INTERCONNECT DIAGRAM
[ REV 2.1 — DUAL PROCESSOR + PROFET CUTOFF + 9 SERVO CHANNELS + 4 ENCODERS + 5 FSRs + ISOLATED EMG ]
Separates High-Current Servo Return (GND_POWER) from Logic Return (GND_LOGIC)
Eliminates 400mV Inductive Ground Bounce | Meets IEC 60601-1
2. DUAL-PROCESSOR CO-DESIGN: NVIDIA JETSON ORIN NANO & ESP32 SUPERVISOR
Vision Supplies Passive Context Only (Never Closes)
Independent Hardware Gating, FreeRTOS Watchdog & ADC Ingestion
• Boots Disarmed: GPIO25 set HIGH immediately; R6 holds HIGH.
• Watchdog: Independent Task WDT latches fault if stalled > 350ms.
• Heartbeat: Jetson 50Hz heartbeat loss (>250ms) trips hardware OE drop.
• E-Stop Strike: < 100 µs ISR tristates PCA9685 PWM outputs.
• Jetson operating system CANNOT override ESP32 supervisor cutoff.
• Dual-frame CRC16-CCITT-FALSE validation on all UART telemetry.
SYSTEM INTERFACE PROTOCOL & DETERMINISTIC CONTROL ARCHITECTURE
• Master 100 Hz Downstream SENSOR Frames: ESP32 streams [Header, Type=0x01, Seq, FSR1..5 (10B), EMG1..2 (4B), CRC16].
• Upstream 50 Hz HEARTBEAT Frames: Jetson sends [Header, Type=0x02, Seq, ArmRequest, WatchdogAck, CRC16].
• CRC16 Polynomial: CCITT-FALSE 0x1021 (Init 0xFFFF) executed via 256-entry O(1) flash lookup table in < 2.5 µs.
• Heartbeat Timeout: If Jetson fails to emit valid heartbeat within 250 ms, ESP32 drops /OE immediately.
• Force Saturation Ceiling: FSR > 3500 ADC counts flags instant backoff (>100ms warning, >500ms safety latch fault).
• Uncommanded Motion: AS5600 encoder velocity > 20 deg/s during hold state trips closed-loop position fault.
• EMG Intent Supremacy: Extensor spike (>0.65 threshold) executes unconditional open override in ≤ 15 ms.
• Vision Assistance Boundary: Computer vision supplies aperture preshaping ONLY; can NEVER trigger or advance closing.
SERVO RAIL A: 5x MG996R FINGER ACTUATORS (6V 15A BUS)
Pulse: 650 - 2350 µs | Stall: 2.5A @ 6V | Peak Torque: 10 kg·cm
Pulse: 650 - 2350 µs | Stall: 2.5A @ 6V | Slew Rate: 4.5 rad/s
Pulse: 650 - 2350 µs | Stall: 2.5A @ 6V | Slew Rate: 4.5 rad/s
Pulse: 650 - 2350 µs | Stall: 2.5A @ 6V | Slew Rate: 4.5 rad/s
Pulse: 650 - 2350 µs | Stall: 2.5A @ 6V | Slew Rate: 4.5 rad/s
SERVO RAIL B: 3x DS3225 WRIST + 1x DS3218 FOREARM (6V 15A)
J8 / M8: WRIST RADIAL / ULNAR DEVIATION (DS3225)
ACTUATION ELECTRICAL RATINGS, THERMAL BUDGET & SAFETY MARGINS
1. Arm Gate: Servos receive zero PWM pulses while system is disarmed or faulted.
2. Hardware OE Interlock: ESP32 supervisor controls /OE (Pin 23); tristates all 16 PWM lines in <100 µs.
3. Slew Rate Limiter: All commanded position steps clamped to 4.5 rad/s (MG996R) and 3.0 rad/s (DS3225).
4. Dual PROFET Disconnect: Depressing E-stop physically severs 12V supply to both 6V buck stages in < 35 µs.
5. Thermal Margin: BTS50015 junction temp monitored; auto-latches off at 175°C with hysteresis.
4. FINGERTIP TACTILE FORCE SENSING (5x INTERLINK FSR402)
PRECISION VOLTAGE DIVIDER & ESD CLAMP SCHEMATIC TOPOLOGY (TYPICAL 1 OF 5)
FSR CHANNEL 1: THUMB DISTAL PAD (J16 / FSR1)
Connector: 2-Pin Molex PicoBlade (1.25mm Pitch) | Wire: AWG 26 Ultra-Flex Silicone
Components: R1 (10.0kΩ 0.1% 25ppm) + C7 (0.1µF X7R Ceramic) + TVS1 (SP3002-04UTG)
Routing: Pin 1 -> +3V3_LOGIC | Pin 2 -> R1 Divider Node -> Low-Pass Filter -> TVS Clamp
Hardware Fault Diagnostics: Disconnect < 10 counts (0.01V) | Crushed Sensor ≥ 4090 counts (3.29V)
Dynamic Force Ceiling: Autonomous grasp slip backoff triggered at > 350 grams force
FSR CHANNEL 2: INDEX DISTAL PAD (J17 / FSR2)
Connector: 2-Pin Molex PicoBlade (1.25mm Pitch) | Wire: AWG 26 Ultra-Flex Silicone
Components: R2 (10.0kΩ 0.1% 25ppm) + C8 (0.1µF X7R Ceramic) + TVS2 (SP3002-04UTG)
Routing: Pin 1 -> +3V3_LOGIC | Pin 2 -> R2 Divider Node -> Low-Pass Filter -> TVS Clamp
Hardware Fault Diagnostics: Disconnect < 10 counts (0.01V) | Crushed Sensor ≥ 4090 counts (3.29V)
Dynamic Force Ceiling: Autonomous grasp slip backoff triggered at > 350 grams force

Connector: 2-Pin Molex PicoBlade (1.25mm Pitch) | Wire: AWG 26 Ultra-Flex Silicone

Routing: Pin 1 -> +3V3_LOGIC | Pin 2 -> R3 Divider Node -> Low-Pass Filter -> TVS Clamp
Hardware Fault Diagnostics: Disconnect < 10 counts (0.01V) | Crushed Sensor ≥ 4090 counts (3.29V)

Connector: 2-Pin Molex PicoBlade (1.25mm Pitch) | Wire: AWG 26 Ultra-Flex Silicone

Hardware Fault Diagnostics: Disconnect < 10 counts (0.01V) | Crushed Sensor ≥ 4090 counts (3.29V)

FSR CHANNEL 5: LITTLE DISTAL PAD (J20 / FSR5)
Connector: 2-Pin Molex PicoBlade (1.25mm Pitch) | Wire: AWG 26 Ultra-Flex Silicone

Routing: Pin 1 -> +3V3_LOGIC | Pin 2 -> R5 Divider Node -> Low-Pass Filter -> TVS Clamp
Hardware Fault Diagnostics: Disconnect < 10 counts (0.01V) | Crushed Sensor ≥ 4090 counts (3.29V)
Dynamic Force Ceiling: Autonomous grasp slip backoff triggered at > 350 grams force
5. CLOSED-LOOP ROTARY ENCODERS: TCA9548A MULTIPLEXER & 4x AS5600
Prevents All-Call Clash with PCA9685 | 400kHz Fast-Mode
RP1, RP2: 4x4.7kΩ I2C BUS PULL-UP RESISTOR ARRAYS
• RP1: 4x 4.7kΩ pull-up network tying SD0..SD3 to +3V3_LOGIC.
• RP2: 4x 4.7kΩ pull-up network tying SC0..SC3 to +3V3_LOGIC.
• Ensures crisp rise times (< 300 ns) across high-flex joint harness.
• Cable shield grounded at TCA9548A ONLY (prevents ground loops).
Channel: TCA9548A Mux CH 0 | Connector: J10 (4-Pin JST-SH 1.0mm Pitch)
Magnet: Diametric N52 Disc (6x2.5mm) | Resolution: 12-Bit (4096 counts/rev)
Channel: TCA9548A Mux CH 1 | Connector: J11 (4-Pin JST-SH 1.0mm Pitch)
Magnet: Diametric N52 Disc (6x2.5mm) | Air Gap: 1.0 mm Nominal
Channel: TCA9548A Mux CH 2 | Connector: J12 (4-Pin JST-SH 1.0mm Pitch)
Magnet: Diametric N52 Disc (6x2.5mm) | Gimbal Flex Bend Radius > 15mm
Channel: TCA9548A Mux CH 3 | Connector: J13 (4-Pin JST-SH 1.0mm Pitch)
Magnet: Diametric N52 Disc (6x2.5mm) | Direct Joint Shaft Tracking
CLOSED-LOOP FEEDBACK MONITORING & JOINT SAFETY ENFORCEMENT
• Continuously tracks tracking error: e_pos = |theta_cmd - theta_meas|.
• If e_pos > 12.0° persists for > 350 ms, safety controller flags STALL FAULT and relaxes tendon tension.
• Prevents mechanical gear stripping, tendon snapping, and motor thermal burnout under object jamming.
• In HOLD or STATIC GRASP mode, joint velocity omega = d(theta)/dt is computed at 100 Hz.
• If omega > 20.0 deg/s while hold is asserted, flags UNCOMMANDED MOTION FAULT and alerts operator.
3. HARDWARE BUS RECOVERY & CLOCK STRETCHING MITIGATION:
• I2C Bus Lockup Recovery: If SDA is held LOW by a hung slave, Jetson bit-bangs 9 clock pulses on SCL.
• Redundant switch avoidance: HAL caches active multiplexer channel to avoid extraneous I2C bus traffic.
• Total 4-channel scan latency: 0.82 ms at 400 kHz Fast-Mode.
• Shielded twisted pair (STP) wiring with 30 twists/meter prevents inductive crosstalk from 6V servo rails.
• JST-SH positive latch connectors rated for > 200,000 wrist gimbal articulation cycles.
6. BIOMEDICAL EMG INTERFACE & GALVANIC ISOLATION BARRIER (IEC 60601-1 TYPE BF)
1.5 kV GALVANIC ISOLATION BARRIER MOAT (CREEPAGE > 5.5mm | ZERO COPPER)
• Creepage Gap: 5.5 mm on raw PCB.
short CANNOT conduct to user skin.
ISOLATED PATIENT CONTACT DOMAIN (ZONE 3 — FLOATING BODY BF)
Connected to Galvanically Isolated Ground (GND_ISO) | Zero Direct Current to Battery
J14 / EMG1: MYOWARE 2.0 MUSCLE SENSOR #1 (FLEXOR CARPI RADIALIS)
Biological Role: HAND CLOSE INTENT | Envelope Filter: 15 Hz Rectified & Integrated
Connector: 3-Pin JST-XH (2.54mm Pitch) | Cable: Shielded 3-Conductor Medical Cable
Pinout: Pin 1 (+3V3_ISO), Pin 2 (GND_ISO), Pin 3 (EMG1_ENV Output to ADS1115 A0)
Patient Contact: Ag/AgCl Gel Snap Electrodes on Mid-Forearm Muscle Belly
J15 / EMG2: MYOWARE 2.0 MUSCLE SENSOR #2 (EXTENSOR DIGITORUM)
Biological Role: UNCONDITIONAL HAND OPEN OVERRIDE (HIGH-PRIORITY SAFETY GATED)
Connector: 3-Pin JST-XH (2.54mm Pitch) | Cable: Shielded 3-Conductor Medical Cable
Pinout: Pin 1 (+3V3_ISO), Pin 2 (GND_ISO), Pin 3 (EMG2_ENV Output to ADS1115 A1)
Safety Guarantee: Triggering Extensor Digitorum unconditionally opens hand within ≤ 15 ms.
J21 / AUX: AUXILIARY CRANIAL / EEG ELECTRODE INPUT (RESERVED)
Channel: ADS1115 Analog Input A2 | Connector: 3-Pin JST-XH (2.54mm Pitch)
Intended for future BCI (Brain-Computer Interface) intent expansion or sensory feedback.
Fully protected behind the 1500 VDC galvanic isolation barrier.
